rationale: Both cover the one live ground-truth concern (bobboli's FLASHINFER_ATTN quant being silently ignored, with X and Y each proposing the restrict-to-TRTLLM fix plus an alternative), and both note the already-resolved sage_kwargs gating in passing. X contributes a distinctive, well-evidenced CI test-selection gap finding and the doc-deletion issue, but its report reads denser/harder to parse and trails off mid-sentence in its final bullet. Y demonstrates deeper hands-on verification (actual REPL output, local test run, FlashInfer source inspection), surfaces an additional plausible correctness bug (dtype mismatch under SAGE) and a ring-SP silent-drop gap by extending an existing analogous guard, and organizes findings by severity with concrete drop-in diffs, making it marginally more actionable and precise overall.
